description: Build the tabbed activity section container
steps: Create ActivityTabs component in web/src/components/event/activity-tabs.tsx
Implement tab navigation: Comments, Top Holders, Activity
Use URL hash or state for active tab persistence
Add smooth transition between tab content
Show count badge on Activity tab (recent trades count)
Make tabs scrollable on mobile if needed

description: Build comments tab with coming soon placeholder
steps: Create CommentsTab component with placeholder UI
Display 'Comments coming soon' message with icon
Show fake comment input (disabled) to show intent
Add call-to-action to join community/Discord
Style consistently with other tabs

description: Build top holders display using proxy data
steps: Create TopHoldersTab component
Use useTopHolders hook from Sprint 00 for data fetching
Display table: Rank, Wallet (truncated), Position, Value
Make wallet address clickable (link to trader profile)
Add copy button for full wallet address
Show loading skeleton during fetch
Show empty state if no holders

description: Build individual top holder row component
steps: Create TopHolderRow component with consistent styling
Display rank number with medal icons for top 3
Show wallet avatar (jazzicon or blockie)
Truncate wallet address with copy-on-click
Format position size in shares
Format value with $ prefix
Add hover state with full details tooltip

description: Build the recent trades activity feed using proxy data
steps: Create ActivityFeed component
Use useMarketTrades hook from Sprint 00 for data fetching
Display trade items: Wallet bought/sold X shares at Y price
Show relative time (e.g., '2 min ago')
Color code buy (green) vs sell (red)
Add infinite scroll or 'Load more' button
Show trade size in dollars
Create ActivityItem component for trade display
Display: Wallet avatar (jazzicon), Address, Action, Size, Price, Time
Use icons: ArrowUp for buy, ArrowDown for sell
Add subtle animation on new items appearing
Handle long wallet names with truncation
Make wallet address clickable to trader profile

description: Handle loading and empty states for activity
steps: Create ActivitySkeleton with animated placeholder items
Show 'No recent activity' for empty data
Add retry button on fetch failure
Show stale indicator if data is older than 1m
Configure React Query refetchInterval (30s for trades)
Highlight new trades that appear since last fetch
Add 'New activity' banner at top when new trades arrive
Pause polling when tab is not visible (document.hidden)
Add manual refresh button
